history.summary: A very large 2,303 sqft 999-year unit at Parry Court (2005) near Kovan, asking $2.45M. The low headline PSF ($1,064) is purely a size artifact — this is a $2.45M oversized unit above the liquid band in an older small Kovan development with essentially no URA price signal (1 txn).
history.rating_rationale: $1,064 psf looks cheap but 2,303 sqft drives the price to $2.45M, above the deepest buyer band and into a small-development, 12-min-from-MRT context. Only 1 URA txn means no reliable appreciation read. 999-yr tenure and the low PSF give some floor value, but the oversized layout narrows the resale pool to family own-stayers, not investors.
red_flags: Oversized 2,303 sqft unit — low PSF is a size artifact, total price $2.45M sits above liquid band
Only 1 URA transaction — no usable appreciation signal
12 min / 1.03 km from Kovan MRT — weak transit pull
Older 2005 development, likely small/boutique with limited facilities
catalysts: Low PSF leaves headroom if a family buyer values the space
